prompt: In a vibrant anime style illustration, a mountain campsite nestles against towering, snow-capped peaks under a twilight sky. On the left side of the frame, a girl with short blue hair sits cross-legged on a green sleeping bag, her eyes wide with anticipation as she holds a metal mug. Next to her, a small brown dog rests its chin on her knee, looking up expectantly. In the center, a man in a red scarf stands beside a crackling campfire, holding a long stick with a marshmallow at the end. He is pointing toward the right side of the scene with his free hand, directing attention to a tall woman with long black hair who is unzipping a large orange tent. Beside her, a boy wearing round glasses kneels on the grass, carefully arranging firewood into a neat pile. Behind them, partially obscured by the tent flap, a raccoon peeks out, its masked face visible as it watches the group. The girl with blue hair is handing a spare blanket to the boy with glasses, who reaches out to accept it with a grateful smile. The man in the red scarf looks at the woman with long black hair, ensuring the tent is secure before night falls. There is no modern technology such as smartphones or laptops visible in this rustic setting. The scene captures a moment of cooperative camping, with each character engaged in a specific task or interaction that contributes to the communal atmosphere of the outdoor adventure.
